title: Streaming Gap Sentry & Route Dive — comparative p50/p95/p99 dashboards by model/route
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Deliver a set of dashboards and alerting hooks that make streaming vs non-streaming latency regressions visible per model + route, with p50/p95/p99 comparisons, root-cause links into traces, and per-request shaping (conversation vs single-shot).

Scope:
- Build a "Streaming Gap Sentry" dashboard that surfaces deltas (streaming - non-streaming) for p50/p95/p99 by model and route, highlighting regressions against historical baselines.
- Add a "Route Dive" drilldown that lets SRE/engineers select a model+route and see time-series, cohort histograms, error rates, and top traces.
- Instrument tracing hooks to capture stream chunk timings (first-chunk, inter-chunk gaps, last-chunk) and correlate with overall latency.
- Ensure metrics/log pipelines emit the derived streaming gap metric and store cohorts for 30 days.
- Wire alerts for when streaming p95 gap widens beyond configured SLO thresholds for >5 minutes.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: cohort replay tooling, quota-aware sampling strategies (follow-up), and long-tail (p999) exploration.

Key implementation notes:
- Use existing latency ingestion pipeline; add a lightweight preprocessor to compute streaming_gap = pX_streaming - pX_nonstreaming per 5m window.
- Tracing: add a binary attribute "io.mode" (streaming|non-streaming) and chunk timing span names (chunk.send/receive). Keep payload minimal to avoid trace cardinality explosion.
- Dashboard UX: top table sorted by streaming_gap_p95, with sparkline, % delta vs baseline, and a one-click link to trace explorer filtered to the cohort.
- Performance/cost: pre-aggregate metrics at 1m resolution and roll up to 5m for dashboard queries to limit cost.

Risks and trade-offs:
- Adding new derived metrics increases pipeline cost; mitigate with sampling and retention policy.
- Trace cardinality must be constrained; only attach detailed span for traces sampled for debugging (1-2% sampling), but emit lightweight chunk timing histogram in metrics for all requests.

Rollout plan:
1. Add metric producer and schema change behind feature flag (canary on internal org).
2. Deploy dashboard to internal team dashboards and validate signals for 48 hours.
3. Open beta for platform users (notify via changelog), monitor cost and false positives for 2 weeks.
4. GA when false positive rate < 5% and cost delta acceptable.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming_gap metric (p50/p95/p99) emitted and visible in metrics store for all routes for the last 30d
Dashboard shows top 50 model+route rows sorted by streaming_gap_p95 and supports date-range and cohort filters
Drilldown links open trace explorer pre-filtered to the selected model+route and io.mode
Alert rule created and tested: streaming p95 gap > 200ms and >20% increase vs baseline for 5m triggers a PagerDuty notification
Documentation updated (Confluence) with instrumentation schema and SLO guidance
